prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one original medieval game dialogue portrait, designed to read on a 74 by 100 pixel canvas.
Primary request: substantively redraw LUOSHAN, a woman in her fifties, as a tightly framed head portrait. Image 1 is her identity/costume reference, not a body or face to crop. Images 2–5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore style references only: match their coarse, sculptural face planes and crowded head portrait scale; never copy their identities.
Identity: retain the original compact broad face, broad practical nose, short wide mouth, square lower face and dark brown side-parted hair. Make her visibly in her fifties: weight at lower cheeks, restrained crow's feet, nasolabial planes and lightly greying temple strands, with firm experienced brows and matter-of-fact bounded patience. She is a skilled basket craftswoman who can decline work, not a sentimental grandmother or smiling saint.
Latest character-card update overrides old head-covering omission: a modest worn straw working hat with frayed narrow brim, over the old beige linen hair wrap at the back; keep her brown hair visible and the source visible ear fully intact. Hat must fit compactly and not eclipse the face. Retain a very narrow wine-red work-clothing neckline and a tiny brown apron-strap glimpse.
Composition: large face dominates; three-quarter turned slightly viewer-left, short neck, only a narrow collar strip at bottom. Face itself about 52–58 logical pixels tall, head incl hat about 88 logical pixels, narrow shoulders. Entire hat/brim, hair, visible ear and scarf knot are inside canvas with genuine 3–5 logical pixels of transparent margin on all outer sides. No edge clips or fake padded clipping. Do not expand into bust, torso or full-body.
Style: restrained old-school gritty medieval pixel portrait. Broad contiguous nose bridge, cheekbone, eye-socket and jaw blocks. Small dark eye openings with tiny muted grey-cream sclera, never white toy eyes. Crisp deliberately stepped edges, limited low-saturation earth palette, ideally under 32 opaque colors. Simplify hat into a few coherent straw blocks without fine weave; large face clusters are the point. No smooth painted gradients, photographic texture, vector lines, scattered dithering, eyelashes or beauty makeup.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha; clean opaque subject pixels. No background color, checkerboard, glow, outline sticker, text, labels, frame or watermark. One portrait only.
